description:
Create a Blueprint - the governance contract validation runs against.

    A Blueprint defines what correct means for your data: fields, the math
    that must hold between them, and acceptable ranges. Start from
    load_rule_pack or discover_patterns if you have no rules yet; invoke
    the blueprint_guide prompt for the full rule/constraint reference.
    Returns the new Blueprint's API key.

customer_name.description: Organization or project name (also used for storage folder naming)
customer_name.title: Customer Name

derivation_rules.description: Math rules as objects. Types: add, subtract, multiply, divide, round, copy, sum (multi-operand), items_multiply, items_sum. Each needs 'type' plus its fields; see the blueprint_guide prompt
derivation_rules.title: Derivation Rules

derived_fields.description: Field names the platform computes from other fields, e.g. ['subtotal','total']
derived_fields.title: Derived Fields

enable_anomaly_detection.description: Flag records that break no rules but do not fit the reference pattern
enable_anomaly_detection.title: Enable Anomaly Detection

extracted_fields.description: Field names the agent extracts from source data, e.g. ['vendor','qty','unit_cost']
extracted_fields.title: Extracted Fields

formal_constraints.description: Constraint objects. Types incl. magnitude_anchor {field,min,max}, relative_anchor {field,reference_field,ratio_min,ratio_max}, max_action_threshold {field,threshold,on_violation}, required_fields {fields}, equals, range, in_set, regex_match, items_magnitude_anchor; see the blueprint_guide prompt
formal_constraints.title: Formal Constraints

mode.description: observe: platform checks the agent's work; enforce: platform computes derived fields itself
mode.title: Mode

require_high_assurance.description: Strictest mode: every check must pass
require_high_assurance.title: Require High Assurance

require_provenance.description: Require extraction source locations for fields
require_provenance.title: Require Provenance

workflow_name.description: Unique Blueprint identifier; the value passed as 'blueprint' in validate
workflow_name.title: Workflow Name

name: create_blueprint
